primary_user_goal: Understand what Railway offers and evaluate if it fits my deployment needs
primary_business_goal: Convert visitors to sign-ups through clear value proposition
copy_summary: Hero section emphasizes instant deployments with visual representation of the project canvas. Tagline focuses on speed and simplicity. Social proof from recognizable companies. Feature grid highlights key capabilities without overwhelming.
notes: Landing page brilliantly shows the actual product canvas as the hero image, letting developers immediately understand the visual infrastructure management concept. Dark theme establishes developer-focused identity. The 'Start a New Project' CTA is action-oriented rather than generic 'Sign Up'.

primary_user_goal: Visualize and manage all services in my project at a glance
primary_business_goal: Demonstrate value through clear infrastructure visualization
copy_summary: Minimal text, visual-first approach. Service cards show status, resource usage, and connection lines. Environment selector prominent. Canvas is zoomable and pannable.
notes: The canvas paradigm is Railway's signature innovation. Services appear as cards with visual connections showing dependencies and networking. Real-time status updates with color-coded indicators. The infinite canvas metaphor scales elegantly from simple to complex architectures. Connection lines auto-route intelligently.

primary_user_goal: Deploy my code to Railway with minimal configuration
copy_summary: Progressive form with smart defaults. Source detection auto-identifies framework. Build commands pre-populated. Clear explanation of what happens next.
notes: Deployment flow is remarkably streamlined. Railway auto-detects the framework (Next.js, Rails, Django, etc.) and pre-configures build settings. The 'zero-config' philosophy means most users can deploy with a single click. Advanced options are available but hidden by default using progressive disclosure.

primary_user_goal: Manage secrets and configuration for my services securely
primary_business_goal: Enable proper configuration management to reduce support burden
copy_summary: Clean table layout with key-value pairs. Masked values by default with reveal toggle. Environment inheritance clearly indicated. Reference variables explained with examples.
notes: Environment variables management is thoughtfully designed. The reference syntax (${{service.VARIABLE}}) enables linking between services. RAW editor mode allows bulk editing. Environment inheritance means variables can be shared across staging/production with overrides. Import from .env file reduces migration friction.

primary_user_goal: Debug issues by viewing real-time and historical logs
primary_business_goal: Reduce support tickets by enabling self-service debugging
copy_summary: Terminal-style log display with color-coded log levels. Search bar prominent. Time range selector. Real-time streaming with pause capability.
notes: Log viewer feels native to developers with terminal aesthetics. Real-time streaming updates automatically. Color coding for ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG levels aids quick scanning. Search supports regex. The ability to filter by deployment helps debug specific releases. Timestamp precision is excellent.

primary_user_goal: Quickly provision a managed database for my application
primary_business_goal: Increase platform stickiness through managed data services
copy_summary: Grid of database options with icons and brief descriptions. Estimated pricing shown. One-click provisioning emphasized. Connection details auto-generated.
notes: Database provisioning is delightfully simple - single click to spin up PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, or MongoDB. Connection strings are auto-generated and can be referenced as environment variables. The visual consistency with the canvas maintains spatial memory. Region selection is prominent for latency-conscious developers.

primary_user_goal: Find and deploy a pre-configured application stack quickly
primary_business_goal: Accelerate adoption by reducing setup time for common patterns
copy_summary: Searchable grid of templates with screenshots, descriptions, and deploy counts. Categories include databases, frameworks, and full stacks. Community contributions highlighted.
notes: Template marketplace is a major differentiator. Curated templates for Ghost, Strapi, n8n, Plausible, and hundreds more. Deploy counts provide social proof. Fork capability encourages customization. The marketplace creates a flywheel effect - more templates attract more users who create more templates.

primary_user_goal: Understand my current spending and estimate future costs
primary_business_goal: Build trust through pricing transparency and predictability
copy_summary: Real-time usage metrics with cost estimation. Breakdown by service. Visual graph of spending over time. Clear plan limits and overage rates. Spending controls prominent.
notes: Pricing transparency is exceptional. Real-time cost estimation removes 'bill shock' anxiety. Service-level attribution helps optimize spending. Spending limits prevent runaway costs. The 'estimated monthly' projection uses actual usage patterns. This transparency builds trust and reduces churn.

primary_user_goal: Configure project-wide settings like environments and team access
primary_business_goal: Enable team collaboration to drive enterprise adoption
copy_summary: Organized settings with sidebar navigation. Environment management for staging/production. Team member roles and permissions. API token generation. Danger zone for destructive actions.
notes: Settings follow conventional patterns developers expect. Environment creation is seamless - duplicate existing environment with variable overrides. Team roles (Admin, Developer, Viewer) map to common permission models. Danger zone with red styling and confirmation dialogs prevents accidental deletions.

primary_user_goal: Monitor deployment progress and troubleshoot build issues
primary_business_goal: Reduce deployment failures through clear feedback
copy_summary: Split view with deployment timeline on left, logs on right. Build phases clearly delineated. Commit information linked. Status prominently displayed. Rollback option accessible.
notes: Deployment detail view provides excellent visibility into the build/deploy process. Timeline shows phases (clone, build, deploy) with durations. Real-time log streaming during builds. Error states are clearly highlighted with actionable suggestions. Rollback is always one click away for quick recovery.
